title: Scout craft powering up and accelerating at 8,000 to 12,000 mph

tellings.quote: One of the things I personally watched them do from a distance cuz if you get too close the fields will burn you like a microwave,

plain: Between 1965 and 1967, in the Indian Springs Valley in Nevada, small scout craft would power up and shoot off at 8,000 to 12,000 miles per hour, according to a man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years near tall white beings at a Nevada base. He tells Michels he watched this himself, but only from a distance, because "if you get too close the fields will burn you like a microwave".
